package parsers

import (
	"net/http"

	"github.com/go-playground/validator/v10"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/filters"
)

// ParseModuleFilters parses module list filters from query params.
func ParseModuleFilters(r *http.Request, validator *validator.Validate) (filters.ModuleFilters, error) {
	var result filters.ModuleFilters
	var err error

	if courseID, err := parseStringParam(r, "course_id", validator, ""); err != nil {
		return filters.ModuleFilters{}, err
	} else if courseID != nil {
		result.CourseID = *courseID
	}
	if scope, err := parseStringParam(r, "scope", validator, ""); err != nil {
		return filters.ModuleFilters{}, err
	} else if scope != nil {
		result.Scope = *scope
	}
	if result.TechID, err = parseIntParam(r, "tech_id", validator, "min=1"); err != nil {
		return filters.ModuleFilters{}, err
	}

	return result, nil
}
